text_block_list.text:
When we all watched a horror movie together that
Kiseki got to study horror directing—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It's there! It's definitely right behind you!!
Why aren't you turning around?! I can't take this!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, what if we changed the lights
in that room to pink?
I think... it'd be super cute♡”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah! Loves-chan is desperately trying to make it look non-scary! Bouquet-chan! Is Bouquet-chan alri—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Awawa... Were you so scared you started crying?
I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...No, not that—
I just felt... terribly sorry for it...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh? Feel bad for them... Who do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Um... I was talking about
the ghost chasing after us—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Right now, the ghost... has taken the form of something very large and pitch black...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"However—isn't his true form
actually that of a little boy...?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
N-No way!? That didn't
come up at all, you know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
However, to me...
it looks like the ghost has been crying out,
'I'm lonely,' 'Help me'—this whole time...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Could chasing after it also be... because I'm afraid of being alone? That's what I wondered—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah―― You're right! This ghost
really does have that kind of hidden backstory!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
However, how did you notice?
There wasn't a single scene where you could tell—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In the very first scene of the story...
There was a photo of a little boy with flowers placed before it—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! That's amazing, Bouquet-chan!
To think you remembered such small details!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Aaargh, I'm so mad I didn't notice it! The clue was right there in the first scene—that's a total classic in manga, too!

"Perhaps watching movies sharpened her observational skills,
as Curren Bouquetd'or's field of vision
during races had expanded as well."
